sections.title: 三、听力理解 (第一段对话)

audio.text: Tom: Hi, Lily. Where did you go last winter holiday? Lily: I visited Dali. It's one of the most famous places in Yunnan. Tom: What did you see there? Lily: There are beautiful lakes, mountains and old streets. I love Erhai Lake. It's one of the biggest lakes in Yunnan. I took a walk around it! Tom: That sounds fun! I want to go there someday.

questions.prompt: Where did Lily go last winter holiday?
options: Beijing.
Dali.
Shanghai.
questions.translation: 莉莉去年寒假去了哪里？——大理。
questions.explanation: 根据对话“Lily: I visited Dali.”可知她去了大理。

options: She took a walk.
She rode a bike.
She climbed a mountain.

sections.title: 四、听力理解 (第二段对话)

audio.text: Good morning, class! Today let's talk about Xu Xiake, a famous ancient Chinese traveller. Over 400 years ago, he travelled all over China. He loved nature and explored mountains, rivers and caves. He wasn't rich, but his family supported him. During trips, he often got lost in deep mountains with no roads or people. He never gave up. Every night, he wrote down what he saw. He travelled for about 30 years. His notes became a famous book. Isn't that amazing?

questions.prompt: What problems did Xu Xiake face during his trips?
options: He had no money and no map.
He met dangerous animals and bad weather.
He often got lost and had no one to ask for help.
questions.translation: 徐霞客在旅行中遇到了什么问题？——他经常迷路且无人求助。
questions.explanation: 根据独白“he often got lost in deep mountains with no roads or people.”可知。

questions.prompt: What did Xu Xiake do every night on his trips?
options: Drew pictures of mountains.
Wrote down what he saw.
Wrote letters to his family.
questions.translation: 徐霞客在旅行的每晚做什么？——写下他看到的东西。
questions.explanation: 根据独白“Every night, he wrote down what he saw.”可知。

questions.prompt: How long did Xu Xiake travel in his life?
options: About 30 years.
About 20 years.
About 40 years.
questions.translation: 徐霞客一生旅行了多久？——大约30年。
questions.explanation: 根据独白“He travelled for about 30 years.”可知。

audio.text: Hi, everyone. Today I want to talk about Sanjiangyuan National Park. It is the biggest national park in China. It is called the "Water Tower of China". Three great rivers start here: the Changjiang River, Yellow River and Lancang River. The park has rivers, mountains, lakes and grasslands. The most famous animal is the snow leopard. Sanjiangyuan is wonderful, but it is very easy to be damaged. We can take care of it by doing small things: saving water, not throwing rubbish, and so on. Let's work together to protect this park and the animals. Thank you!

questions.prompt: The speech is about the biggest national park in China.
questions.translation: 演讲关于中国最大的国家公园。
questions.explanation: 根据原文“It is the biggest national park in China.”可知正确。

questions.prompt: The Lancang River starts in Sanjiangyuan.
questions.translation: 澜沧江发源于三江源。
questions.explanation: 根据原文“Three great rivers start here: the Changjiang River, Yellow River and Lancang River.”可知正确。

questions.prompt: There aren't grasslands in Sanjiangyuan.
questions.translation: 三江源没有草地。
questions.explanation: 根据原文“The park has rivers, mountains, lakes and grasslands.”可知有草地，故错误。

questions.prompt: The snow leopard is the only animal in Sanjiangyuan.
questions.translation: 雪豹是三江源唯一的动物。
questions.explanation: 原文提到“The most famous animal is the snow leopard”，并没有说它是唯一的动物，故错误。

questions.prompt: We should save water to help protect Sanjiangyuan.
questions.translation: 我们应该节约用水来帮助保护三江源。
questions.explanation: 根据原文“We can take care of it by doing small things: saving water...”可知正确。

sections.passage:
Dunhuang Winter Camp
Topic: Dunhuang, an ancient city on the Silk Road in Gansu, China.
Time: 9:00 am Monday-Friday (Closed on Saturday & Sunday)
Activities and Classes:
• Learn about Mogao Caves: Enjoy the pictures of over 45,000 square metres of murals

sections.title: 十三、阅读理解 A (Meet China's Huge Bridge)
sections.passage:
On September 28, the Huajiang Grand Canyon Bridge(花江峡谷大桥) was officially opened. The bridge is the highest bridge in the world. It is 625 metres high. This bridge is in Guizhou, China. To make sure it was safe and strong, engineers(工程师) checked it carefully. They drove 96 trucks(卡车) onto the bridge. Each truck weighed 35 tons (吨), so altogether they weighed 3,360 tons. Finally, the bridge passed the test.
• This bridge can stay strong in level 14 winds.
• Special panels(板子) on both sides of the bridge help guide(引导)the wind and make it less powerful.

questions.prompt: When was the Huajiang Grand Canyon Bridge officially opened?
questions.translation: 花江峡谷大桥是什么时候正式通车的？
questions.explanation: 根据文章“On September 28, the Huajiang Grand Canyon Bridge was officially opened.”可知选A (On September 28)。

questions.translation: 花江峡谷大桥有多高？
questions.explanation: 根据文章“It is 625 metres high.”可知选C (625 metres)。

questions.explanation: 根据参考答案给出的ACBBC对应题序，第3题选B (1420 metres) 或按标准答案。

questions.explanation: 根据文章“To make sure it was safe and strong, engineers checked it carefully. They drove 96 trucks onto the bridge.”可知选B (To check if the bridge was safe and strong)。

sections.title: 十四、阅读理解 B (Travel is really fun!)
sections.passage:
Travel is really fun! Let's read about the three Chinese people who loved travelling and did amazing things.

Sima Qian
Sima Qian was a great historian from the Han Dynasty. He took many trips across different parts of China. During these trips, he met new people and visited new places. These experiences helped him write Shiji. This book tells us a lot about China's early history.

Li Bai
Li Bai was a great poet of the Tang Dynasty. He loved travelling a lot. He visited many beautiful mountains and rivers. The great views on his trips inspired him. Then he wrote lots of wonderful poems. People still enjoy his poems now.

Xu Xiake
Xu Xiake was a famous traveller from the Ming Dynasty. He spent about thirty years travelling across China, mostly on foot. Xu wrote down his travel experiences in his diary. This later became Xu Xiake's Travel Diaries. Thanks to this book, we can learn about China almost 400 years ago.

These stories show us that travel can bring us new ideas and help us do great things. Maybe you'll have amazing travel stories to tell one day, too!

questions.translation: 司马迁来自……
questions.explanation: 根据短文“Sima Qian was a great historian from the Han Dynasty.”可知选C (the Han Dynasty)。

questions.explanation: inspired意为“激发灵感，给予灵感”，对应B (gave him ideas)。

questions.explanation: 根据短文“mostly on foot”可知选C (He travelled on foot most of the time)。

questions.translation: 将人物与其主要成就进行匹配。
questions.explanation: 司马迁-①写历史书，李白-③写风景诗，徐霞客-②写游记，对应B项。
